<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_snc_campusmatch_campusmatch_claim</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>CampusMatch - Portal Claim Notifications</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    var service =
        new CampusMatchNotificationService();


    function normalize(value) {

        return (
            value || ''
        )
        .toString()
        .toLowerCase()
        .trim();

    }


    function changed(fieldName) {

        return (
            current.isValidField(fieldName) &&
            current[fieldName].changes()
        );

    }


    var claimantId = '';


    if (
        current.isValidField('claimant')
    ) {

        claimantId =
            current.getValue('claimant') || '';

    }


    if (
        !claimantId &&
        current.isValidField('u_claimant')
    ) {

        claimantId =
            current.getValue('u_claimant') || '';

    }


    var matchId = '';


    if (
        current.isValidField('match')
    ) {

        matchId =
            current.getValue('match') || '';

    }


    if (
        !matchId &&
        current.isValidField('u_match')
    ) {

        matchId =
            current.getValue('u_match') || '';

    }


    if (
        !claimantId &&
        matchId
    ) {

        var match =
            new GlideRecord(
                'x_snc_campusmatch_campusmatch_match'
            );


        if (
            match.get(matchId)
        ) {

            var lostId =
                match.getValue('lost_item') ||
                match.getValue('u_lost_item');


            if (lostId) {

                var lost =
                    new GlideRecord(
                        'x_snc_campusmatch_campusmatch_item'
                    );


                if (
                    lost.get(lostId)
                ) {

                    claimantId =
                        lost.getValue('reporter') || '';

                }

            }

        }

    }


    if (!claimantId) {
        return;
    }


    var claimId =
        current.getUniqueValue();


    var matchTarget =
        matchId
            ?
            (
                '?id=campusmatch_match&match_id=' +
                matchId
            )
            :
            '?id=campusmatch_dashboard';


    /* OWNERSHIP VERIFICATION RESULT */

    if (
        changed('u_verification_result')
    ) {

        var result =
            normalize(
                current.getValue(
                    'u_verification_result'
                )
            );


        if (
            result === 'pass'
        ) {

            service.createForUser(
                claimantId,
                'student',
                'Ownership verification passed',
                'Your ownership answers passed automated verification.',
                matchTarget,
                'claim',
                current.getTableName(),
                claimId,
                'verification_pass:' + claimId,
                'CampusMatch - Ownership Verification Pass'
            );

        }


        if (
            result === 'review'
        ) {

            service.createForUser(
                claimantId,
                'student',
                'Ownership claim under review',
                'Your ownership claim needs staff review.',
                matchTarget,
                'claim',
                current.getTableName(),
                claimId,
                'verification_review:' + claimId,
                'CampusMatch - Claim Under Review'
            );


            service.notifyAdmins(
                'Ownership claim requires review',
                'A CampusMatch ownership claim requires a staff decision.',
                '?id=campusmatch_admin_review&claim_id=' +
                    claimId,
                'claim',
                current.getTableName(),
                claimId,
                'admin_claim_review:' + claimId,
                'CampusMatch - Claim Under Review'
            );

        }


        if (
            result === 'fail'
        ) {

            service.createForUser(
                claimantId,
                'student',
                'Ownership verification failed',
                'Your ownership answers did not pass automated verification.',
                matchTarget,
                'claim',
                current.getTableName(),
                claimId,
                'verification_fail:' + claimId,
                'CampusMatch - Ownership Verification Fail'
            );

        }

    }


    /* CLAIM STATUS */

    if (
        changed('claim_status')
    ) {

        var status =
            normalize(
                current.getValue(
                    'claim_status'
                )
            );


        if (
            status === 'approved'
        ) {

            service.createForUser(
                claimantId,
                'student',
                'Item ready for collection',
                'Your claim was approved. Follow the collection instructions in CampusMatch.',
                matchTarget,
                'collection',
                current.getTableName(),
                claimId,
                'claim_approved:' + claimId,
                'CampusMatch - Item Ready for Collection'
            );

        }


        if (
            status === 'rejected'
        ) {

            service.createForUser(
                claimantId,
                'student',
                'Claim rejected',
                'Your ownership claim was not approved.',
                matchTarget,
                'claim',
                current.getTableName(),
                claimId,
                'claim_rejected:' + claimId,
                'CampusMatch - Claim Rejected'
            );

        }


        if (
            status === 'withdrawn'
        ) {

            service.createForUser(
                claimantId,
                'student',
                'Claim withdrawn',
                'Your ownership claim has been withdrawn.',
                matchTarget,
                'claim',
                current.getTableName(),
                claimId,
                'claim_withdrawn:' + claimId,
                'CampusMatch - Claim Withdrawn'
            );

        }

    }


    /* COLLECTION COMPLETED */

    if (
        changed('handover_completed') &&
        current.getValue('handover_completed') == '1'
    ) {

        service.createForUser(
            claimantId,
            'student',
            'Collection completed',
            'Your item handover has been successfully completed.',
            '?id=campusmatch_dashboard',
            'collection',
            current.getTableName(),
            claimId,
            'collection_complete:' + claimId,
            'CampusMatch - Collection Completed'
        );

    }

})(
    current,
    previous
);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-29 09:02:41</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>5fd02d3ad52b03107f4491472fd3df9a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CampusMatch - Portal Claim Notifications</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="CampusMatch" source="x_snc_campusmatch">50fd9dde64d703107f44b7462480e65b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CampusMatch">50fd9dde64d703107f44b7462480e65b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_5fd02d3ad52b03107f4491472fd3df9a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-29 09:02:41</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=5fd02d3ad52b03107f4491472fd3df9a"/></record_update>
